sources/groups/international/items/5/goo.en: Daily records of Chinese military aircraft entering Taiwan's air defence identification zone, with named compilers.

sources/groups/international/items/5/tip.zh-TW: 各來源對次數的口徑不同（進入 ADIZ 或周邊偵獲、飛機與艦艇是否合計），數字對不上很常見。
sources/groups/international/items/5/tip.en: Sources count differently (entering the ADIZ versus detected nearby, aircraft and ships combined or not), so their totals often disagree.

sources/groups/finance/items/0/good.zh-TW: 把上市櫃財報做成圖表與選股條件，多數功能免費。

sources/groups/finance/items/2/good.en: A securities and macro database with over 30 years of history, widely used in academic research.

sources/pitfalls/0/body.zh-TW: 三成左右的資料集標題帶民國年，欄位裡的「114」是西元 2025 年；同一支 API 也可能民國、西元混用。
sources/pitfalls/0/body.en: About three in ten dataset titles carry ROC years: "114" in a field means 2025. A single API can mix ROC and Gregorian dates.

sources/pitfalls/1/body.zh-TW: 約一成資料集仍是 Big5 編碼的 CSV，直接用 UTF-8 打開會是亂碼，先轉碼。
sources/pitfalls/1/body.en: About one dataset in ten is still a Big5-encoded CSV, which turns to gibberish if opened as UTF-8; convert it first.

sources/pitfalls/2/body.zh-TW: 1,187 個資料集只有 PDF，月報也常是 PDF；要用程式讀得先解析。
sources/pitfalls/2/body.en: 1,187 datasets exist only as PDFs, and monthly bulletins often are too, so they have to be parsed before use.

sources/pitfalls/3/body.zh-TW: 薪資平均數會被高薪拉高，中位數才是一半的人賺得比這少的那條線；人力銀行的薪資調查跟主計總處口徑不同，不能直接比。
sources/pitfalls/3/body.en: Average wages are pulled up by high earners; the median is the line half of workers fall below. Job-site salary surveys use a different basis from official statistics and cannot be compared directly.

sources/pitfalls/4/title.zh-TW: 同一個數字有好幾個版本

sources/pitfalls/4/body.zh-TW: 台灣人口在國際彙整站上能差到十幾萬人，因為各自用不同年份、不同推估。查台灣的數字，以發布它的台灣官方機關為準，並寫出期間。
sources/pitfalls/4/body.en: International aggregators disagree on Taiwan's population by over a hundred thousand because they use different years and estimates. Use the Taiwanese agency that publishes the figure, and state the period.

sources/pitfalls/5/body.zh-TW: 政府網站常只給即時值不留歷史，也會整批下架（疾管署 2026 年 8 月一次下架 234 個病例統計資料集）。用到的資料，記下取得日期與網址。
sources/pitfalls/5/body.en: Government sites often show only the present and can withdraw data in bulk (in August 2026 the CDC pulled 234 case-statistics datasets at once). Record the date and URL of anything you use.

sources/pitfalls/6/body.zh-TW: 政府資料開放授權條款允許商業使用、與 CC BY 4.0 相容，但沒有標示原提供機關，就視為自始沒有取得授權。
sources/pitfalls/6/body.en: Taiwan's open government data licence allows commercial use and is compatible with CC BY 4.0, but reuse without naming the original agency counts as never having been licensed.

sources/pitfalls/7/title.zh-TW: 國際資料庫可能沒有台灣

sources/pitfalls/7/body.zh-TW: 世界銀行、WHO、UNESCO、UNDP 都沒有台灣這一列。用它們做國際比較時，台灣那一格要改用台灣官方統計，並註明來源不同。
sources/pitfalls/7/body.en: The World Bank, WHO, UNESCO and UNDP have no Taiwan row. When comparing with them, fill Taiwan's cell from Taiwan's official statistics and note the different source.

story/overview/title.zh-TW: 七十五年，台灣變成今天這個樣子
story/overview/title.en: Seventy-five years: how Taiwan became what it is today

story/overview/essay.zh-TW:
1950 年底，台灣有 755 萬人，那一年出生了 32 萬個嬰兒。1951 年平均每人 GDP 換算成美元是 154 元（名目，當年 1 美元兌 10.3 元新臺幣），1960 年農業還占全國產值的二成八。戒嚴令從 1949 年 5 月 20 日起實施，一實施就是三十八年。

接下來七十五年，人口一路長到 2019 年底 2,360 萬人的高點，然後開始減少。出生數在 1963 年最多，有 42.7 萬人，2025 年只剩 10.8 萬人。平均每人 GDP 在 2025 年是 39,515 美元，農業占產值跌到 1.44%，工業的比重則從 2000 年之後回升，2025 年是 43.45%，是 1987 年以來最高。

這些變化發生的先後，解釋了台灣今天的很多樣子：經濟起飛在戒嚴時期就開始了，1966 年高雄加工出口區啟用，1980 年新竹科學園區啟用。民主化接在經濟成熟之後，1987 年解嚴，同一年台積電成立，1996 年第一次總統直選，2000 年第一次政黨輪替。

所以今天的台灣同時是這幾件事：5 奈米以下的先進晶片約九成由台積電生產，每 5 個人就有 1 位 65 歲以上，解嚴到現在還不到四十年。三件事互相牽動，晶片帶來的成長要撐起一個正在變老的社會，成長怎麼分配，交給一個年輕的民主來決定。

下面七章，每一章從一個數字切進去：它怎麼變成今天這樣、會推動社會的哪些地方，再連到站上相關的文章。
story/overview/essay.en:
At the end of 1950 Taiwan had 7.55 million people, and 320,000 babies were born that year. GDP per person in 1951 came to US$154 (nominal, at that year's rate of NT$10.3 to the dollar), and in 1960 farming still made up 28% of national output. Martial law took effect on 20 May 1949 and lasted thirty-eight years.

Over the next seventy-five years, the population grew to a peak of 23.6 million at the end of 2019 and then began to fall. Births peaked in 1963 at 427,000; in 2025 there were 108,000. GDP per person reached US$39,515 in 2025; farming's share of output fell to 1.44%, while industry's share has climbed back since 2000, to 43.45% in 2025, its highest since 1987.

The order in which these changes happened explains a great deal about Taiwan today: the economic take-off began under martial law, with the Kaohsiung Export Processing Zone opening in 1966 and Hsinchu Science Park in 1980. Democratisation followed a mature economy: martial law was lifted in 1987, the year TSMC was founded; the first direct presidential election came in 1996 and the first change of ruling party in 2000.

So Taiwan today is several things at once. About 90% of the world's most advanced chips, at 5 nanometres and below, are made by TSMC; one person in five is 65 or older; and martial law ended less than forty years ago. The three pull on one another: the growth chips bring has to support an ageing society, and how that growth is shared is decided by a young democracy.

Each of the seven chapters below starts from one number: how it came to be what it is, what it sets in motion across society, and which stories on the site tell more.

story/overview/chartTitle.zh-TW: 出生數最多的一年是 1963 年，人口要到 2019 年才到頂
story/overview/chartTitle.en: Births peaked in 1963; the population did not peak until 2019

story/overview/source.zh-TW: 內政部戶政司人口統計資料（年底人口、出生數、三階段人口）、主計總處國民所得統計（平均每人 GDP、產業結構）。1970 年以前的人口與出生數不含金門、連江（1963 年出生數是含金馬的全國數字）。每人 GDP 以當年匯率換算成美元，1955 到 1960 年的下降來自匯率變動。1960 到 1980 年的產業結構是舊制國民所得口徑，跟之後的數字不宜直接相減。
story/overview/source.en: Department of Household Registration (year-end population, births, population by age group); DGBAS national accounts (GDP per person, industry structure). Population and births before 1975 exclude Kinmen and Lienchiang (the 1963 birth figure is the national total including them). GDP per person is converted to US dollars at each year's exchange rate; the fall from 1955 to 1960 reflects the exchange rate. Industry shares for 1960–1980 use an older national-accounts definition and should not be compared directly with later figures.
